recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5299 unless a future PA decision separately changes AppointmentResponse or broadens the Appointment description.
issue_request: FHIR-5299 was a Published PA change request from the January 2015 ballot, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to replace Appointment's old scheduled-healthcare-event description with wording that describes Appointment as a booking of a healthcare event among patient(s), practitioner(s), related person(s), and/or device(s) for a specific date/time, possibly resulting in one or more Encounter(s).
initial_application: Git commit 24ca87254f870290ca62f47e268355be7a08d5cd, titled "Tracker# 5198, 5199, 5299 Ballot Reconciliation updates(& QA clean-up)", changed source/appointment/appointment-spreadsheet.xml from the obsolete scheduled-healthcare-event wording to the resolved booking wording. Later refactors moved the preserved wording into source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists appointment=Appointment and appointmentresponse=AppointmentResponse. The current Appointment StructureDefinition contains the resolved text in the resource description, short, and definition. AppointmentResponse was listed as a related artifact in Jira, but the request and historical implementing diff target Appointment's description, and no source or community evidence showed a separate AppointmentResponse change was required for this ballot comment. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current active source already satisfies the Jira resolution, and a source-wide search found no remaining copy of the obsolete wording.
